Hello, my name is Ann Hayes.

Thank you, Ann. Could you also confirm your date of birth for verification purposes?
My date of birth is the second of August, nineteen seventy-five.
Great, thank you for the information, Ann. Is there anything specific you need assistance with today?
I have some questions about my policy coverage.
Of course, I can help with that. Thank you for reaching out, Ann. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all for now. Thank you, Harold.
